meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、数据或标志做成几秒的动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让标题、数据或品牌标志动起来,做成一段短视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, data, or a logo into a short animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to animate headlines, stats, or a brand mark into a short clip

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为短片做设计导向的动态图形:动态文字、数字滚动、图表、logo 出场、地图动画、推文卡片等,通常 10 秒内、无旁白;它会先出校验快照,经你同意后导出 MP4 或透明叠加视频。
howto.when: 当你要一段无旁白、10 秒内的短片(动态文字、数字滚动、logo 出场等)时接管;更长、有旁白或多场景的内容转到 /general-video,不确定则走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用动态文字做一条 8 秒的产品口号短片,不要旁白
say.note: 它会先规划镜头,再问你要预览还是渲染

say.text: 做一个数字从 0 涨到一百万的数据图表动画
say.note: 纯文字/代码类不用搜索素材,直接设计

say.text: 做一条高亮美国西部几个州、并连线到纽约的地图动画
say.note: 需要素材时会先搜索,再据此设计

howto.what_en: Claude builds short, design-led motion graphics: kinetic type, count-ups, charts, logo stings, map moves, tweet cards. Under 10s, no narration; it shows proof snapshots, then renders MP4 or transparent overlay after your approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want a narration-free clip under 10s (kinetic type, stat count, logo sting, etc.). Longer, narrated or multi-scene pieces route to /general-video; unclear cases go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make an 8-second kinetic-type clip for our product slogan, no narration.
say_en.note: It plans the shot, then asks whether to preview or render.

say_en.text: Animate a number counting up from 0 to a million as a chart.
say_en.note: No search needed — it designs straight from your text.

say_en.text: Highlight Western US states and draw a line to New York as a map animation.
say_en.note: If assets are needed it searches first, then designs.
